ingredients: 800 g ba chỉ (pork belly), cut in large cubes
3 muỗng canh nước mắm (3 tbsp fish sauce)
2 muỗng canh đường (2 tbsp sugar), for the caramel
1 trái dừa tươi (1 young coconut), the juice
4 tép tỏi, 2 củ hành tím (4 garlic cloves, 2 shallots), minced
steps: Marinate the pork with the fish sauce, garlic and shallots for 30 minutes.
Melt the sugar in a dry pot until it turns dark amber.
Add the pork and stir until every piece is coated and browned.
Pour in the coconut juice, bring to a boil and skim the foam.
Add the eggs and simmer uncovered for about 90 minutes, until the pork is tender.
